"""RoboPaint 愛: camera-calibrated brush strokes, no simulator state access."""
import sys,json,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=Path('/app/output');RUNS=Path('/app/runs')
r=Robot()
Q=np.array([0.,1.,0.,0.]); ZP=.0202

def observe(name,cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam'],depth=False):
 o=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras,depth=depth);o.save(str(RUNS/name))
 for cam,im in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(RUNS/name/(cam+'.png'))
 return o

def execute(poses,name,cameras=['practice_cam'],fps=5):
 poses=np.array(poses);out=[]
 for k in range(0,len(poses),180):
  a=poses[k:k+180];np.save(ROOT/(name+f'_{k}_actions.npy'),a)
  status=r.status();(ROOT/(name+f'_{k}_before.json')).write_text(json.dumps(status))
  res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=.05,cameras=cameras,video='frames',video_fps=fps,note=name)
  res.save(str(RUNS/(name+f'_{k}')))
  print(name,k,'tip',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3].round(6).tolist(),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),'remaining',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
  out.append(res)
 return out

def line(a,b,speed=.04):
 n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(np.array(b)-a)/speed/.05)))
 return [list(p)+list(Q) for p in np.linspace(a,b,n+1)[1:]]

def move(points,name,speed=.04):
 now=r.get_obs(cameras=[]).group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3];poses=[]
 for p in points:
  poses+=line(now,p,speed);now=np.array(p)
 poses += [list(now)+list(Q)]*10
 return execute(poses,name)

if __name__=='__main__':
 if sys.argv[1]=='park':
  move([[0,0,.14],[-.1,.20,.14]],'park',.06);observe('park',depth=True)
